observationsNotFindings.observation: The landing recital ('Lands CODEX-D282-SF1, … All five identifiers are named.') appears verbatim in the Protocol line, in 'Why this entry exists', and in Decision item 1, and its two same-class sentences appear a fourth time in the Turn 1 paragraph.

observationsNotFindings.observation: For the Claude Stage A review, 'after both reviewers' merits measurements at e4b20dd' rests on that review's single recorded liveState.head; the Claude Stage A review has no end-of-review HEAD re-check. Recorded so that a later successor does not turn this into a wall-clock claim about when Claude's individual digest checks ran.
